title: Minor Treatment Checklist
subtitle: Capture requested service, guardian authority, qualified decision, and consent limit; confirm encounter result and follow-up.
description: Minor Treatment records requested service, guardian authority, qualified decision, consent limit, encounter result, and follow-up. Minor Treatment evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this minor treatment stage-gated verification when staff must document requested service and guardian authority. Reconcile qualified decision, consent limit, encounter result, and follow-up before the minor treatment handoff. Use the service request, minor and guardian identity checks, authority documentation, qualified recommendation, itemized consent, encounter record, aftercare instructions, and follow-up receipt. This authorization centers a minor, guardian or other lawful authority, a named treatment or procedure, qualified explanation, itemized limits, encounter result, aftercare receipt, and guardian follow-up. Ask the assigned minor treatment reviewer to confirm requested service against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Minor Treatment starting details review
sections.guidance: Name requested service, minor and guardian, custody or authority source, qualified decision maker, consent limits, encounter outcome, aftercare route, and follow-up. Keep any urgent minor treatment issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Minor Treatment exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current minor treatment facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Minor Treatment required checks
items: Requested service is identified for this record
Guardian authority matches the current request or source
Qualified decision is ready for point-of-use staff
Consent limit limits or questions are resolved
Encounter result is communicated to the responsible person

blocks.label: Minor Treatment failed or pending items

sections.title: Minor Treatment readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold minor treatment readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Minor Treatment reviewer receipt

fields.label: Receiving department or clinical reviewer and date

blocks.guidance: Minor Treatment receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
